key_insight: Lean 4.0 maintenance practices reduced welding-machine downtime by a reported 375 minutes per year in a steel galvanizing line.
engineering_relevance: Standardized maintenance and operator training can improve welding-machine reliability and support continuity in galvanizing operations.
method: Empirical case study of a welding machine in a continuous galvanizing line.
Standardized welding-disc replacement and introduced a machine checklist.
Trained staff to improve maintenance execution.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 375 minutes less annual total welding-machine downtime against a historical baseline of 496 minutes per year attributed specifically to welding-disc failures.
watch_item: The single-machine case study and differing downtime scopes limit generalization and prevent a directly comparable percentage-reduction claim.
paper_title: Lean maintenance 4.0: Enhancing welding machine reliability in steel galvanizing processes
